title: 1.11.1 and 1.10.3 patch releases
summary: The body of the opening message is not in the bundle; the replies show a proposal for 1.11.1 and 1.10.3 patch releases built around a v3 correctness fix (PR #16699). Everyone who replied supported both releases. Amogh Jahagirdar created a 1.10.3 milestone and added a fix that preserves encryption metadata when DVs change (PR #15911) and a default-value fix for evaluation against Parquet metrics (PR #16692); he also reported the 1.11.x branch had been created. Matt Butrovich offered a fix for manifest delete file size after table rewrite (PR #15470) as a backport candidate for both lines. Kevin Liu asked to fix the iceberg-rest-fixture Docker image in 1.11.x (PR #16214). On milestones, Amogh said every fix going into 1.10.3 should also go into 1.11.1, while fixes that are not critical correctness issues should go only into 1.11.

positions.stance: Supports both releases; the fix is a contained v3 correctness fix and v3 correctness fixes should keep being backported to 1.10.
Supports both patch lines and wants the iceberg-rest-fixture Docker image fixed in 1.11.x so publishing can be re-enabled.
Include the fix preserving encryption metadata for DV changes in 1.10.3, because the issue amounts to producing incorrect V3 metadata.
The fix for manifest delete file size after table rewrite is a backport candidate for both 1.10.x and 1.11.x.
Everything patched into 1.10.3 should be in 1.11.1, but non-critical fixes should go only to 1.11 to limit the backport burden.

outcome.note: All replies supported doing both 1.11.1 and 1.10.3; a 1.10.3 milestone and the 1.11.x branch were created and candidate fixes were being collected. No release candidate is announced in the thread.

why_it_matters: It sets the backport rule for the two patch lines: critical correctness fixes go to both 1.10.x and 1.11.x, other fixes only to 1.11.x.
